title: Kissed Arabian Chicken Roast
description: A comforting roast chicken infused with aromatic Middle Eastern spices, Thai sweet basil, and a tangy horapa glaze, perfect for a Mediterranean-friendly dinner.

ingredients.name: horapa sauce
ingredients.notes: orange marmalade 4 tbsp, soy sauce 2 tbsp, honey 1 tbsp, rice vinegar 1 tbsp, lime juice 1 tbsp

instructions: Season the chicken with salt, pepper, paprika, cumin, and coriander, then rub with olive oil and place on a roasting pan.
Squeeze lemon halves over the chicken and scatter crushed garlic cloves around it.
Roast the chicken for 50 minutes, basting with the horapa sauce every 15 minutes.
During the last 10 minutes of roasting, add Thai sweet basil leaves to the pan.
Remove the chicken from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before carving.
Serve the roast chicken with a sprinkle of fresh parsley and extra horapa sauce on the side.
Enjoy with warm flatbread or a side of rice for a complete meal.
